newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 22.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - Paramount's "The First Wives Club" debuted with a record-shattering $19 million to lead the weekend box office.
HOLLYWOOD - News Corp is spinning off its highly successful Fox Children's Network into a partnership with Saban Entertainment.

HOLLYWOOD - John Travolta committed to two high-profile films on Friday, one in which he'll portray a wildly ambitious politician, in a Universal Pictures film, and in the other, a personal injury attorney, in a Touchstone Pictures film.
HOLLYWOOD - NBC's domination of Thursday night continued into the new season, as it won every time period and key demographic group.
